topic: Demonstration on insertion and extraction of pins of aircraft electrical plugs.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration on insertion and extraction of pins of aircraft electrical plugs.
specific_objectives: 24.13.1.1 Trainee will be able to carry out workshop maintenance on aircraft cables and PCBs.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration on insertion and extraction of pins of aircraft electrical plugs; Safety precautions: Wear gloves and eye protection; Instructor supervision: Direct observation and correction of technique.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of aircraft electrical plugs?
Why is proper pin alignment critical during insertion?
What safety gear is required before handling aircraft electrical connectors?

topics: Identification of pin types and configurations
development.content:
Identification of pin types and configurations
Pre-insertion inspection and cleaning procedures
Correct alignment and insertion technique
Verification of secure locking mechanism
Proper extraction and removal sequence

topics: Common errors in pin insertion and extraction
Handling of different voltage ratings safely
Storage and protection of removed plugs
development.content:
Common errors in pin insertion and extraction
Troubleshooting damaged or corroded pins
Handling of different voltage ratings safely
Documentation of maintenance actions
Storage and protection of removed plugs

Final verification of plug integrity
Reassembly and testing procedures
Reporting discrepancies to maintenance control
Review of safety protocols
Preparation for periodic inspection

summary_questions: Describe the correct sequence for extracting pins from an aircraft electrical plug.
Explain the potential consequences of forcing pins into a misaligned connector.
How do you verify that a plug is securely locked after insertion?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between standard and high-voltage aircraft electrical plugs, referencing the procedures covered in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Explanation on the evaluation of periodicity and level of calibration of STTE and CRETE.
